boundary: One persistent private CUDA context. Each timer includes production C ABI admission, witness decoding, proving, serialization and caller output copies. Caller input/output preparation, context startup/shutdown, artifact writes and independent CPU verification are excluded. The matching public batch shape is warmed before measured trials.
case_order: Each suite uses a fresh process. Fixed case order, one warmup then three measurements per case; public batch kind/padded height may evict the previous cached shape.

resources.cgroup_observation_boundary: Last live sample; final exited cgroups were already removed. Successful exit, memory peaks and inactive service state were recorded.

driver_build.boundary: Each standalone driver links the previously qualified production rlib without rebuilding or changing crate source.

limitations: Wallet batch and legacy LJSTREE1 container qualification only; not full 64-entry or 128-entry recursive block aggregation.
LJSTREE1 remains a container of independently proved leaves, not recursion.
The 63-entry cases test padding to the 64-tile limit; these cases do not exhaust all counts or witness distributions.
Current timing excludes CPU verification, input/output preparation, startup/shutdown, network/consensus and complete node/host processing.

Serial input-rate extrapolations are not measured sustained transaction throughput or pool timing approval. Separate fixed-order screens do not establish an optimal batch size or a speedup over another backend.
Larger tree containers, multi-GPU concurrency, V100 execution and matched CPU/OpenCL comparisons remain open.
No new sanitizer run accompanies these larger production API tests; prior primitive sanitizer coverage is recorded separately.
